title: 17. Ieſus Chriſt the onely med • atou • ordained and promiſed.

segments.text:
THis one and all onely meane is th• miſterye of the incarnation of th• ſonne of god with all that which foloweth it, who was from age to ag• promiſed euen from a Adam vnto ſain•
Ihon was publiſhed and preached b• the patriarkes as prophetes, was all fygured diuers wayes vnder the law as is at large contained in the bokes 〈…〉 the olde Teſtamente, to the ende tha• man moughte be ſaued by faythe 〈…〉 Ieſus Chriſt for to come.
